description: This file is a Node.js script written in modern JavaScript/ECMAScript module syntax. It acts as a build and runner script that manages build dependencies, triggers build processes, checks repository status, and runs some runtime post-build steps for a project, likely related to a TypeScript or JavaScript codebase with specific build configurations and extensions.

methods.name: normalizePath
methods.description: Normalizes a file path by replacing all backslashes with forward slashes.

methods.name: isIgnoredSourcePath
methods.description: Checks if a source path should be ignored based on its filename suffix such as test files.

methods.name: isBuildRelevantSourcePath
methods.description: Determines if a source path is relevant for build based on file extension and ignore rules.

methods.name: isBuildRelevantRunNodePath
methods.description: Checks if a repository path is relevant for build considering configuration and source directories.

methods.name: isRestartRelevantExtensionPath
methods.description: Checks if a path is relevant for restart based on known metadata or source relevance.

methods.name: isRestartRelevantRunNodePath
methods.description: Checks if a repository path is relevant for restart considering configuration, source, and extensions.

methods.name: statMtime
methods.description: Gets the modification time of a file, returns null if not accessible.

methods.name: isExcludedSource
methods.description: Determines whether a source file should be excluded based on its path and relevance for building.

methods.name: findLatestMtime
methods.description: Recursively finds the latest modification time within a directory, applying a skip filter.

methods.name: readGitStatus
methods.description: Runs 'git status' to get the current repository status for watched paths.

methods.name: parseGitStatusPaths
methods.description: Parses the output of 'git status' to extract relevant file paths.

methods.name: hasDirtySourceTree
methods.description: Checks if the source tree has uncommitted changes or modifications relevant for build.

methods.name: readBuildStamp
methods.description: Reads the build stamp JSON file to obtain last build metadata.

methods.name: hasSourceMtimeChanged
methods.description: Checks if source files have newer modification times than the build stamp.

methods.name: resolveBuildRequirement
methods.description: Determines whether a rebuild is necessary based on environment, timestamps, and repository status.

methods.name: formatBuildReason
methods.description: Maps internal reasons for build necessity to human-readable labels.

methods.name: logRunner
methods.description: Logs messages to stderr with a specific prefix unless suppressed.

methods.name: runOpenClaw
methods.description: Spawns a process to run the main openclaw script and waits for completion.

methods.name: syncRuntimeArtifacts
methods.description: Calls post-build function to generate runtime artifacts, catching errors.

methods.name: writeBuildStamp
methods.description: Writes the current build metadata to disk.

methods.name: runNodeMain
methods.description: Main function that manages the build process, checks, and execution of the openclaw runtime, with build prerequisite logic.
